description.narrative: Note: Disbursement data provided is cumulative and covers disbursement made by the project Agency.

The project's overall objective is to pioneer integrated and innovative approaches to catalyzing more inclusive, sustainable, and resilient food systems transformation in four African countries while distilling lessons and knowledge that can inform and inspire the way forward with continental and global agendas and programs.

This project is designed as an enabling activity, which will contribute broadly to multiple aligned socioeconomic outcomes at both national and local levels. This includes environmental and climate benefits, food security and nutrition benefits, and livelihoods benefits around poverty reduction and job creation. Considering that the project will facilitate the development of new investable pipelines and flagship programs in the targeted countries, it is reasonable to assume that each flagship program will directly benefit at least 500,000 individual small and medium-sized farmers. Combining the 4 flagship programs in the 4 targeted countries, the project is expected to benefit 2 million individuals directly. However, since the project's impact will also be realized through changes in policy-level outcomes that drive the transformation of food systems while enhancing climate resilience, and considering that over 60% of the population in the targeted countries is directly or indirectly involved in agriculture and related food system sectors, approximately 66 million people (representing 60% population of the targeted countries) are expected to benefit from these gains through an improved policy environment.
